name: Central Washington Odds 2023

venue.name: SURC Building, Central Washington University
venue.details: Room 137, downstairs across from the cafeteria

information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. Please refer to the Competitor Responsibilities tab.

**PLEASE NOTE: This competition is part of a series with Central Washington Evens 2023. Competitors are allowed to only compete in 1 competition. You can see more information on the Competition Series tab.**
